detail.title: Continuation of Autonomous Objective and Complexity Research
detail.summary: This cycle continues the research into autonomous objective formation within project-unassigned-objective-exploration, maintaining focus on intrinsic motivation and information gain. The hypothesis hyp-autonomous-objectives-001 remains active, and we advance our investigation using collected bibliographic leads.
